items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 27 at 6:48PM EST until November 28 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
6 to 11 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Oregon Inlet to Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Some infrequent gale force gusts (34kt)
will be possible over outer portions of these waters for a few
more hours.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
